ensemble.full: mean of all 8 madmom blstm models (downbeats_blstm_1..8); this is exactly the model set madmom's DOWNBEATS_BLSTM / RNNDownBeatProcessor uses
ensemble.subset_4x: mean of the first 4 blstm models (downbeats_blstm_1..4); smaller/faster approximation

input.name: pcm
input.resampling: NOT included in the graph - caller must resample to 44100 Hz mono first

output.name: activations_out
output.n_frames: floor(T / 441) + ... exactly ceil(T/441) = madmom end='normal' framing; first frame centered at sample 0

preprocessing_embedded: zero-pad + dynamic framing via Gather (hop=441, hanning window, frame sizes 1024/2048/4096, centered origin like madmom offline mode)
STFT via opset-17 DFT op (onesided, Nyquist bin dropped like madmom)
madmom LogarithmicFilterbank (bands/octave 3/6/12, fmin=30, fmax=17000, norm_filters=True, unique filters) baked as constants
positive temporal diff (lag 1/1/2 frames per resolution, first lag frames zeroed)
hstack [log, diff] per resolution, hstack all -> 314-dim features
graph.rnn: 8x bidirectional LSTM (hidden 25, peepholes P) as native ONNX LSTM nodes + softmax(3) heads, non-beat column dropped, mean over models

validation.reference: madmom 0.17.dev0 RNNDownBeatProcessor on the same 44100 Hz int16 WAV files

runtime_hint: onnxruntime CPU: ~0.55 s for 30 s audio (~55x realtime) on desktop; LSTM peepholes require a runtime with full ONNX LSTM support (onnxruntime >= 1.14 for the DFT op)
